اسحنككت (form XIV)
# اِسْحَنْكَكْتُ (isḥankaktu) /is.ħan.kak.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# اِسْحَنْكَكْتَ (isḥankakta) /is.ħan.kak.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# اِسْحَنْكَكْتِ (isḥankakti) /is.ħan.kak.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# اِسْحَنْكَكَتْ (isḥankakat) /is
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
